description: A client belongs to the branch district of each account they own: join `disp` (OWNER) to `account` and use `account.district_id`, counting the client once per owned account.

c.request: Placing clients in districts by the location of their branch, and counting only districts that have clients: for each region, what is the average number of clients per district, and what is the average share of all clients that a district holds (as a fraction)? Don't round. A client belongs to the branch district of each account they own: join `disp` (OWNER) to `account` and use `account.district_id`, counting the client once per owned account.
c.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM disp p JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id WHERE p.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM d) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(d.n) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(d.n * 1.0 / t.total) AS avg_share FROM d JOIN district di ON di.district_id = d.district_id CROSS JOIN t GROUP BY di.A3

a.request: For each region (`district`.`A3`): place every client in the branch district (`account`.`district_id`) of each account they own (disposition `type` = 'OWNER'), counting a client once per owned account, and count clients per district, considering only districts with at least one client. Give the region, the average of those per-district client counts over the region's districts, and the average over the region's districts of each district's share of clients (its count divided by the total of the counts over all districts, as a fraction); no rounding.
a.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM dc) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(dc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district di ON di.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY di.A3

b.request: Treating each client as belonging to the branch district (`account.district_id`) of every account they own (joining `disp` with type OWNER to `account`, counting the client once per owned account), and including only districts with at least one such client, compute for each region (`district.A3`) the unrounded average number of clients per district and the unrounded average of each district's share of all clients (district client count divided by total client count, as a fraction)
b.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp p JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id WHERE p.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM d) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(d.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(d.cnt * 1.0 / t.total) AS avg_district_share FROM d JOIN district di ON di.district_id = d.district_id CROSS JOIN t GROUP BY di.A3

d.request: Placing clients in districts by their branch location, where a client belongs to the branch district (`account.district_id`) of each account they own (join `disp` with type OWNER to `account`, counting the client once per owned account), and counting only districts that have clients: for each region, what is the average number of clients per district, and what is the average share of all clients that a district holds (as a fraction)? Don't round.
d.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(dc.cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM dc)) AS avg_share_of_clients FROM dc JOIN district di ON dc.district_id = di.district_id GROUP BY di.A3
